item.title: Environmental Management Perspectives on Water Pollution Control and Ecosystem Restoration within the One Water Framework
item.content:encoded:
This special issue in the Journal of Environmental Management focuses on water pollution control and ecosystem restoration through an integrated One Water approach. The call seeks research that addresses environmental management strategies for tackling water pollution while simultaneously restoring degraded ecosystems.
